name: Countdown
whenToUse: Time left until a deadline that matters to the user: a trial ending, a maintenance window starting, “resend code in 0:42”.
A promo end on a landing (`appearance="blocks"`).

anatomy.description: inline `clock` (2d 04:12:09) or `compact` (2d 4h 12m), tiles in `blocks`, or a draining `ring` with the largest unit inside (give `from` so it knows the full span).

do.caption: Inline, minutes are enough for a two-day deadline.

dont.caption: Ticking seconds for a trial: noise that reads like pressure.

a11y: `role="timer"`; the spoken text is a sentence that changes once a minute — screen readers aren’t flooded every second.
Give the deadline as a date too, near the countdown, for people who read it later.
Don’t trigger anything irreversible at zero without telling people first.

props.name: to
props.description: Deadline: a Date, an ISO string or a timestamp in ms.

props.name: appearance
props.description:
`inline` text, `blocks` tiles, or `ring`: a ring that drains as time runs out, with
the largest unit left in the middle and a check at zero (Kinetics' Countdown Ring, MIT).

props.name: completed
props.description: Shown instead of the zeros once the deadline has passed.

props.name: from
props.description: Ring only: when the countdown started, for the share left. Defaults to when it mounted.

props.name: labels
props.description: Unit names (singular, plural) — used for block labels and the spoken text.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Fires once when the countdown reaches zero while mounted.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freezes the countdown at its current value.

props.name: precision
props.description: Smallest unit that ticks. `minutes` re-renders once a minute.

props.name: srText
props.description: Prefix/suffix for the spoken text, e.g. (t) => `Sale ends in ${t}`.

props.name: trimLeading
props.description: Hides leading units that are zero (days, then hours).

props.name: urgentBelow
props.description: Below this many seconds the numbers turn danger.
